description: This file defines the BrowserContextDispatcher class, which manages and dispatches events and actions related to a browser context in the Playwright testing framework. It handles request interception, event subscriptions, page management, and various browser context operations.

classes.name: BrowserContextDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing a browser context, handling events, request interception, and context operations in Playwright.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing BrowserContextDispatcher for a given BrowserContext.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new BrowserContextDispatcher, setting up event listeners and request interception.

methods.name: _shouldDispatchNetworkEvent
methods.description: Determines if a network event related to a request should be dispatched based on subscriptions.

methods.name: _shouldDispatchEvent
methods.description: Checks if an event should be dispatched for a given page or request based on subscriptions.

methods.name: serializeConsoleMessage
methods.description: Serializes a console message into a format suitable for dispatching.

methods.name: createTempFiles
methods.description: Creates temporary files in the context's artifacts directory.

methods.name: exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a binding to the browser context for use in page scripts.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within the browser context.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Retrieves cookies for specified URLs.

methods.name: addCookies
methods.description: Adds cookies to the browser context.

methods.name: clearCookies
methods.description: Clears cookies matching specified criteria.

methods.name: grantPermissions
methods.description: Grants permissions for the context.

methods.name: clearPermissions
methods.description: Clears all permissions for the context.

methods.name: setGeolocation
methods.description: Sets geolocation for the context.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for the context.

methods.name: setOffline
methods.description: Sets offline mode for the context.

methods.name: setHTTPCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP credentials (deprecated).

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds an initialization script to the context.

methods.name: setNetworkInterceptionPatterns
methods.description: Configures request interception patterns.

methods.name: setWebSocketInterceptionPatterns
methods.description: Configures WebSocket interception patterns.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Retrieves the storage state (cookies, localStorage, etc.).

methods.name: setStorageState
methods.description: Sets the storage state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser context.

methods.name: enableRecorder
methods.description: Enables the recorder in the context.

methods.name: disableRecorder
methods.description: Disables the recorder.

methods.name: exposeConsoleApi
methods.description: Exposes console API in the context.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the context (debugging).

methods.name: newCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session.

methods.name: harStart
methods.description: Starts HAR recording.

methods.name: harExport
methods.description: Exports HAR data.

methods.name: clockFastForward
methods.description: Fast-forwards the clock.

methods.name: clockInstall
methods.description: Installs a fixed clock time.

methods.name: clockPauseAt
methods.description: Pauses the clock at a specific time.

methods.name: clockResume
methods.description: Resumes the clock.

methods.name: clockRunFor
methods.description: Runs the clock for a specified duration.

methods.name: clockSetFixedTime
methods.description: Sets a fixed system time.

methods.name: clockSetSystemTime
methods.description: Sets the system time.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates event subscription status.

methods.name: registerSelectorEngine
methods.description: Registers a custom selector engine.

methods.name: setTestIdAttributeName
methods.description: Sets the attribute name used for test IDs.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when disposing the dispatcher.
